notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's wire.rs is the shared codec helper set: packed-guid read/write, LE scalar readers, cstring, Vector3d, and the signed 11/11/10-bit quarter-yard packed spline point. MSUI's Net/ByteBuffer.cs is a declared direct port (packed guid, packed spline point, cstring, LE readers/writers) consumed by every parser; no independent wire-visible contract beyond the encodings, which match including the sign-extension the packed-point decode needs.
